description:
Fair Deal Property, Your Trusted Experts for Residential Property Sales

Are delighted to present to you for sale No. 29 Cois Na Habhainn, an outstanding four-bedroom detached residence over three floors extending to an impressive floor area of 205 sq. m of well laid out living space. 

Presented to the market in walk-in condition, this hugely impressive family home enjoys a superb position at the end of a quiet cul-de-sac in the heart of Abbeyknockmoy village, just a 25-minute drive from Galway City. With no passing traffic, the location offers an ideal environment for families with young children and for all those seeking a peaceful and tranquil setting, while still remaining within easy reach of the city.

On arrival, the property immediately impresses, with an exceptionally large driveway providing ample parking for multiple vehicles. The beautifully presented front garden features manicured lawns and mature shrubs, while generous side access provides additional parking and excellent vehicular access to the rear of the property.

Internally, you are greeted by an exceptionally spacious and light-filled entrance hall, finished with attractive custom wall panelling. To the right is the main living room, a wonderfully generous space featuring an abundance of floor area along with an attractive feature fireplace, while enjoying pleasant views over the front garden and open country side beyond.

On the opposing side of the entrance hall is a second reception room, offering excellent versatility and potentially suitable for use as an additional bedroom, home office or play room. This room also benefits from extensive wall-to-wall built-in storage.

To the rear of the property lies a most impressive kitchen/diner, featuring extensive built-in storage, a central island with breakfast area and a wonderfully bright dining space overlooking the exceptional rear garden. The outdoor space has been extensively upgraded and features a large flagstone-finished patio area, low-maintenance artificial grass and a substantial double garage, providing excellent additional storage and utility space.

A generously appointed utility room, complete with additional storage, together with a fully upgraded downstairs bathroom, completes the ground-floor accommodation for this most impressive detached residence.

On the first floor, there are three spacious double bedrooms. The master bedroom is particularly impressive, offering an abundance of floor space, excellent storage potential and a well-appointed en suite bathroom. An ideal sized office area which is fully illuminated by with an oversized velux window along with  a beautifully presented family bathroom featuring a luxurious jacuzzi bath competes the the mid floor accommodation. 

The accommodation continues into the fully converted attic, providing an exceptionally large and versatile space suitable for a wide variety of uses. Flooded with natural light from the Velux window, this impressive room also benefits from its own en suite bathroom and additional walk-in storage.

Externally, the property is equally impressive, with substantial gardens, excellent parking provision, generous side access and a large double garage. The rear garden has been fully upgraded with artificial grass and designed with ease of maintenance in mind while still providing an outstanding space for outdoor entertaining, relaxation and family life.

No. 29 Cois Na hAbhainn is a truly exceptional detached family home, offering an outstanding combination of space, style, versatility and convenience. With approximately 205 sq. m. of accommodation, multiple reception and living areas, four bedrooms, office suite, several bathrooms, a fully converted attic and superb external amenities, this home can comfortably cater for even the largest of families.

Located within walking distance of Abbeyknockmoy  and just approximately 25 minutes from Galway City, the property offers the perfect balance between peaceful village living and accessibility to the city.

If you are looking for an impressive detached family home of style and substance, presented in walk-in condition and offering exceptional levels of space and versatility, we strongly recommend that you look no further than No. 29 Cois Na hAbhainn.

If this sounds like the home for you, we would be delighted to hear from you and arrange a viewing.

Brought to you by Fair Deal Property — Your Trusted Experts for Residential Property Sales.
